title: UAE Finalizing Trials Of 269 Justitia Asteroid Probe | Aviation Week
excerpt: The UAE is completing tests on its locally built probe that will launch in 2028 with the aim to land on asteroid 269 Justitia in 2034.
content:
October 01, 2026

The United Arab Emirates (UAE) this month aims to complete testing of the Technology Innovation Institute probe it plans to send to the asteroid belt and land on 269 Justitia. The probe has completed vibration testing and is now undergoing thermal cycle testing before comprehensive performance tests...
